manifest.method: Fresh-input settlement replication of original d40409e771af. tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english) per complete pair via tiktoken; English arms rendered in the SAME genre as the target (English = the registered mapping spelled out in full (requires a human decision because <why>; an agent must not resolve it; acting without that decision is out of scope); Ainglish = <action> human_needed(<why>)) so both runs price the same object; per-tokenizer arithmetic mean; headline = maximum tokenizer mean (least favourable).
